confirm.subject: Confirm your Orchester account

alreadyRegistered.subject: You already have an Orchester account
alreadyRegistered.body:
Someone tried to sign up for Orchester with this email, which already has an account.

If it was you, sign in at {url} instead. If you forgot your password, choose Forgot password there.

If it was not you, you can ignore this email; nothing changed.

reset.subject: Reset your Orchester password

invite.subject: You have an invite on Orchester
invite.body:
{inviter} invited you to {target} on Orchester.

You find the invite in your Orchester account at {url}, and in the Orchester app under Settings › Orchester. It waits there until it expires.

inviteToSignUp.subject: You have an invite on Orchester
inviteToSignUp.body:
{inviter} invited you to {target} on Orchester.

To accept it, create an Orchester account with this email at {url}. The invite waits for your account until it expires.

If you do not know {inviter}, you can ignore this email; nothing was created.
